message.content:
Here’s a quick roundup of the most talked‑about crime‑thriller releases from 2020. These films were praised for their tense storytelling, sharp twists, and strong performances.

| # | Title | Director | Key Cast | Why It Stands Out |
|---|-------|----------|----------|-------------------|
| 1 | **The Hunt** | Thomas Vinterberg | Mads Mikkelsen, Nikolaj Coster-Waldau | A chilling psychological thriller that follows a man wrongfully accused of child abuse. Its stark, claustrophobic tone and Mikkelsen’s intense performance earned it critical acclaim. |
| 2 | **The Invisible Man** (2020‑re-release) | Leigh Whannell | Elisabeth Moss, Oliver Jackson-Cohen | Though originally released in 2017, the 2020 re‑release on streaming platforms brought renewed attention. The film blends horror with crime‑thriller elements, focusing on a woman who suspects her abusive partner is stalking her. |
| 3 | **The Last Full Measure** | James Mangold | Tom Hanks, Chris Evans | A war‑drama with crime‑thriller undertones, following a veteran’s quest to clear his friend’s name. The film’s investigative narrative and moral complexity earned it an Oscar nomination. |
| 4 | **The Trial of the Chicago 7** | Aaron Sorkin | Eddie Redmayne, Sacha Baron Cohen | A courtroom drama that doubles as a crime‑thriller, chronicling the 1969 trial of anti‑war activists. Sorkin’s sharp dialogue and the film’s tense pacing made it a standout. |
| 5 | **The Irishman** (2020‑re-release) | Martin Scorsese | Robert De Niro, Al Pacino, Joe Pesci | The 2020 re‑release on streaming platforms revived interest in this epic crime saga. Its long‑form storytelling and De Niro’s nuanced performance earned it widespread praise. |

> **Note:** Some titles listed above were re‑released or streamed in 2020, which is why they’re included in the “best crime‑thriller movies of 2020” list. If you’re looking for original 2020 releases, *The Hunt* and *The Trial of the Chicago 7* are the most prominent.
